for a large class of SPDEs with colored noise, the numerical method converges with rate of order 1/2 in the uniform topology.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the numerical method is robust for a large class of SPDEs with correlated noise.
the rate of convergence is independent of the correlation structure of the noise.
